The '''Skirmish in AB-343''' was a minor skirmish that occurred during the [[Jedi Civil War]].

==Origins==
After the [[Battle of Czerka 431]], the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] technician [[Joni Ree]] defected to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Republic sent her, along with three Republic guards, to try and extract data from a ruined Czerka lab, [[AB-343]]. However, at around the same time, the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] realized that this could expose their alliance with Czerka, so they decided to send a [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] to kill Ree. The [[GenoHaradan]] also decided that it would be in their interest for the alliance to remain a secret, so they also sent an assassin.

==The battle==
The assassins confronted Ree and the Republic troops.
